title: Recovery of a Chromatographic Resin Used in the Prefractionation of Cyanobacterial Extracts
author: Leonardo Santos de Jesus
materials: Solvents and solutions: Extran Methanol (100%), ACS Grade; Ultrapure water, HPLC Grade; Acetone, ACS Grade; Ethyl Acetate, ACS Grade; Isopropanol (100%), HPLC Grade. Resin: Used DIAION TM HP20SS (Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corporation). Equipment: SPE Column (used); Heating mantle; Soxhlet extraction cartridges; Soxhlet extrator coupled to condenser Round-bottom flask; Long spatula and tweezers.

steps.title: Remove Frits from SPE Column
steps.instruction: Remove the frits from the SPE column used for prefractionating cyanobacterial extracts using a spatula and long tweezers.

substeps.instruction: Gently tap the chromatography column on a surface to dislodge the frits, ensuring packed solids are not blown to the surface.
Use a spatula to tilt the frits and remove them with long tweezers, avoiding mixing the extract load with the resin.

steps.title: Collect and Store Resin
steps.instruction: Store the used HP20SS resin in a labeled bottle for recovery.

substeps.instruction: Accumulate resin from multiple fractionation cycles prior to recovery if possible.

steps.title: Clean and Recover Frits
steps.instruction: Clean the removed frits using organic solvents.

substeps.instruction: Soak frits in 100% isopropanol for approximately 1 hour.
Allow frits to dry.
Repeat the soaking procedure using acetone.
Allow frits to dry completely before reuse.

steps.title: Clean Chromatographic Columns
steps.instruction: Clean the chromatographic columns for later use in fractionation.

substeps.instruction: Wash columns with Extran.
Rinse with running water and Milli-Q water.
Rinse with a small amount of methanol to remove Extran residues.

steps.title: Prepare Soxhlet Extraction Cartridge
steps.instruction: Prepare the Soxhlet extraction cartridge inside a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Place the cartridge in a 200 mL beaker and cover completely with ethyl acetate; soak for approximately 1 hour.
Repeat the soaking process with acetone for approximately 1 hour.

steps.title: Load Resin into Cartridge
steps.instruction: Load the recovered HP20SS resin into the extraction cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Fill the cartridge to approximately 60% of its capacity with the used HP20SS resin.
Moisten the resin in the cartridge with 100% isopropanol to prevent overflow during expansion in the organic solvent.

steps.title: Assemble Soxhlet Extractor
steps.instruction: Assemble the Soxhlet extractor using components cleaned with Extran soap and 100% methanol.

substeps.instruction: Insert the moistened resin cartridge into the Soxhlet extractor using long tweezers.
Add 200 mL of 100% isopropanol to a 500 mL flat-bottomed or round-bottomed flask.
Fit rubber tubes for running water (lower tube to faucet, upper tube to sink) and open the valve to ensure continuous circulation through the condenser.
Plug in the heating mantle and set to medium power.
When bubbles appear, slightly reduce power to ensure the organic solvent evaporates slowly.
Perform the extraction for 10 to 15 Soxhlet cycles.
Turn off the heating mantle and wait for the glassware to cool and solvent evaporation to stop.
Replace the isopropanol with 200 mL of acetone.
Moisten the resin in the cartridge with acetone before reintroducing it into the Soxhlet.
Perform the extraction for up to 10 Soxhlet cycles.
Turn off the heating mantle and wait for the glassware to cool.

steps.title: Final Resin Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Process the recovered resin and solvents for storage.

substeps.instruction: Spread the resin in a tray under a fume hood to allow complete evaporation of residual organic solvents.
Store recovered resin and used organic solvents in properly labeled flasks.
